entry.summary: The success of blockbuster hits like "Project Hail Mary" and "Verity" is only part of the story, Amazon's CEO says.

entry.title: You don’t need to believe in a god to get a religious exemption from using AI at work
entry.summary: David Durman, a University of Kentucky administrator, recently earned a religious exemption from using AI in the workplace.

entry.title: Waymo taps Toyota to supply robotaxis for Japan and the UK

entry.title: North Korean hackers blamed for stealing record $6.3B in Binance breach
entry.summary: Hackers working for North Korea are suspected of hacking a Binance employee's laptop, which allowed the theft of billions in crypto.

entry.title: Theranos whistleblower Tyler Shultz warns that the AI boom is ‘a great opportunity to go deceive people’
entry.summary: The cautionary Theranos tale takes on a new significance in the AI era, when companies that have never turned a profit are raising capital at trillion-dollar valuations.

entry.title: Google’s first data center satellite is online and writing poetry
entry.summary: The first TPU in space is running a Google DeepMind Gemma 4 model and writing cheesy poetry.

entry.title: Zest’s new AI agent finds restaurants and books reservations over text
entry.summary: Can't agree on where to eat? Zest's AI concierge can combine everyone's tastes, put restaurant options to a vote, and make the reservation.

entry.title: Satlyt takes another step toward turning satellites into space data centers
entry.summary: Satlyt ran a successful test this month bringing it closer to turning spacecraft, starting with satellites, into virtual data centers.

entry.title: AI law firm Crosby bids on disintegrating, famed firm Weil Gotshal
entry.summary: Like a real-life episode of "Suits," the demise of famed white-shoe Wall Street law firm Weil, Gotshal & Manges has been the talk of the legal industry. And now an AI firm has entered the picture.

entry.title: Cracks are emerging in the AI spending boom
entry.summary: Big Tech is pouring billions into AI infrastructure, but mounting debt, negative cash flow, and growing investor skepticism are raising questions about the sustainability of the AI spending boom.

entry.title: Last-minute Halloween costumes for tech nerds
entry.summary: No Halloween costume? Just be a deceptively cute AI agent icon, a PHP vulnerability, or sleepy time Bryan Johnson.

entry.title: Applebee’s exposed customers’ personal data after leaving database password in app
entry.summary: EXCLUSIVE: A security researcher discovered the hardcoded credential in Applebee's app, allowing unrestricted access to customers' personal data.

entry.title: Anthropic expected to receive high ‘junk’ rating from credit agencies following IPO, FT report says
entry.summary: Blackstone's forecast is just a prediction, but naturally, a high junk rating would make it more difficult and costlier for Anthropic to raise the money to keep funding its massive spending that has undergirded its business.

entry.title: Intel’s stock crashes, knocking $12B from government’s stake
entry.summary: Intel is being hurt by PC sales as the AI industry gobbles memory and other components causing PC prices to rise.

entry.title: Ollie, a privacy-focused AI assistant, is shutting down
entry.summary: As an increasing number of AI assistants flood the market, the founder of Ollie, an assistant that respected its users' privacy, says it will be shutting down in a week.

entry.title: Salesforce’s M&A spree continues with a reported $375M deal for defense tech startup Rune
entry.summary: The AI logistics startup will bolster the CRM giant's Missionforce defense platform.
